levels.name: Silent Sector

startScreen.title: Silent Sector
startScreen.subtitle: Infiltrate a layered security station through lit patrol zones and shadowed service lanes. Visual landmark: Security iris.
startScreen.howToPlay: WASD move · Mouse look · C crouch · Shift sprint · F interact · Esc pause. Stay behind machinery and watch the sentries. Crouching makes less noise. Reach the security wing, take the cyan Data Core, then follow green lights to extraction.
startScreen.controlsHint: C crouch • Use cover • Secure the Data Core
startScreen.credits: Original models, textures and sound by Digital Opus. A pre-release engine example.

levels.description: A short stealth infiltration through a listening security station. Break sightlines, secure the Data Core and escape unseen.

objectiveDefs.title: Reach the Security Wing
objectiveDefs.description: Move past the guards without being caught.
